summary: W18 is the peak load week of the Build (~21 mi, §4.D) and the second full v4.4 three-run week: Mon LONG 65 min / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 4×1 mi / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 8×800m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. It opens against a short W17: the Sat 8-15 VO2 5×1000m @ I was MISSED and there is no make-up — Sun is off by rule under v4.4 and W18 opened on Monday's long, so the session is dropped, not repaid (§11.D, same posture as Adj #214/#233/#250). W17 closed at 2 runs (~13.1 mi) + 2 lifts against a ~20 mi peak target, with both lifts and both remaining runs banked in full and the entire loss on the VO2 — the first outright-missed quality session of the Build, where the three prior weeks each lost easy or long volume instead. In a three-run week that is a third of the running and half the quality (Adj #282). MONDAY DELIVERED IN FULL: 65:00 / 6.50 mi @ 9:59/mi plus a 0.20 mi walked cooldown, the second consecutive long banked in its programmed slot and again the week's entire easy fraction. It also closed the Adj #256 watch, and the splits settle it directly rather than by inference: 10:05 / 9:30 / 9:56 / 10:07 / 9:56 / 10:21 then 0.50 mi at ~10:10, with every mile inside the 9:15–10:30 easy band and the fastest of them 9:30 — 15 s/mi clear of the fast edge and 54 s/mi off W17's quickest. Per-mile power 195/212/201/205/196/193 W never approached the 232/233 W of the W17 pickup miles, HR ran 154/167/174/173/173/173/167 as a warm-up ramp into a flat plateau 6 bpm under W17's finish, and RPE 5 is the confirming subjective read against the §4.D requirement that this run stay genuinely conversational. Cadence 168 is inside the 165–172 easy allowance; HR and power are display-only (Adj #283). Monday was also the first run after Friday's seated-calf 365 sweep, at ~66 h: the compressed Saturday Achilles gate never ran because the VO2 was missed, so the read reverted to exactly the ~66 h Z1 shape Adj #244/#249 designed and closed clean — 365's first exposure produced no Achilles signal at any read, the revert-to-355 branch is dead, and the calf holds 365 on Saturday to rebuild toward the full 4×12 (Adj #284). That leaves two loaded run days. Friday's 8×800m @ I is now the decisive band read: I has been unread since 8-9 and the walked-recovery confound has never been removed, so every term of the Adj #251/#252 ask carries over to a different shape but a fuller dose — open at the 7:00 fast end, 90 s JOG recoveries, ~28 min of work, RPE 9 governing. A second slip sends I into the W19 cut-down (Wed 8-26, §10) on nothing. WEDNESDAY IS LOGGED and the stepped T band 7:40–7:45 is validated on its first outing: 7:41 / 7:44 / 7:41 / 7:38, work avg 7:41/mi over 30:44, RPE 7 across, all four reps inside the band with the fastest one last and the anchor never broken — the Adj #271 revert branch is dead and the step is banked on evidence rather than on directive. The caveat that survives is that RPE 7 "maybe lower" is sub-anchor for a second consecutive T outing, so the band moved 5 s/mi faster and the effort reading did not follow; T therefore enters the cut-down as a conservative candidate alongside I, with no recalc outside tests (Adj #291). Two execution patterns broke in the same session — the fast open, after three straight sessions of it, and the walked recoveries, after two — and the second is direct rehearsal at the same 90 s duration Friday prescribes (Adj #292/#293). Cadence stayed sub-band at 169–173 for a third consecutive road outing and did not rise with the faster pace, so the extra speed came from stride length rather than turnover; Friday gives the fourth road read (Adj #294). TUESDAY IS LOGGED and all three bumps landed. Incline 160×5 came in at RIR 1 — completed, not missed, so the TM stays at 168 with no cut, but one click under the RPE 7 ask and exactly on the Adj #257 revert line; the athlete's call at logging was to hold 160 rather than revert to 155, which overrides that overlay and restores the plain §5 rule, so W19 Tue repeats 1×5 @ 160 (≥RIR 2 takes 165, under five reps is miss #2 and cuts the TM). The AMRAP's flat 11 puts e1RM at ~185 for a third straight reading in the 180–185 band (Adj #285). DB lateral 35 landed across all six sets with the front four carrying reserve, and while the 72 total matches last week's at 30, the RIR line is five clicks deeper — the evidence the retired opener-RIR gate was structurally unable to produce (Adj #286). Rear-delt 145 landed at RIR 3/3, the §3.A ask exactly, and is the first load in the 125→145 chain to arrive on-target rather than short of it (Adj #290). A fourth bump was earned: the preacher put its first full 4×10 at 70 on the board with set 3 finally clean at RIR 1, so 75 fires next Tuesday (Adj #287). The one thing that went backwards is the pushdown, and it went backwards hard — read 2 of 3 came in at 36 total with set 3 at 6, six under the floor and two below what both prior collapses managed, so the trend now spans three sessions across both slots and is worsening rather than oscillating. Volume tolerance at 27.5 is the only reading left standing: the load holds two working sets, not four. That makes Saturday's read 3 a formality and settles W19 Tue as a load-or-set-count conversation — drop to 25, or cut to three sets — with the 2nd-movement expansion off the table. The tendon is not what is limiting the arms; the dose is, with the elbow now 14 consecutive sessions clean (Adj #288).

Against those: pushdown read 2 of 3 came back worse than read 1 — 27.5×12/12/6/6 = 36, set 3 six under the floor and two below what both prior collapses posted — so the trend now spans three sessions across both slots and is worsening, not oscillating (Adj #288). Logged — 4×1 mi @ 7:41 / 7:44 / 7:41 / 7:38, work avg 7:41/mi over 30:44, 90 s recoveries, RPE 7 across ("7 for sure, maybe even lower but 7 at most"). THE STEPPED BAND 7:40–7:45 IS VALIDATED ON ITS FIRST OUTING: all four reps inside the band, the fastest one last, the ≤7 anchor never broken — every term of the Adj #271 test came back on the hold side, so the revert-to-7:45–7:50 branch is dead and the directive step is now banked on evidence rather than on directive. Caveat carried forward: RPE 7 "maybe lower" is sub-anchor for the second consecutive T outing, so the band moved 5 s/mi faster and the effort reading did not move with it — T stays a candidate for conservative alongside I, and no recalc happens outside tests, so the W19 cut-down on 8-26 arbitrates both (Adj #291). Two execution patterns broke the same session: the run opened ON PACE at 7:41 and negative-split, ending the three-session fast-open pattern and rehearsing exactly the discipline the cut-down's M → T → 5K progression needs (Adj #292); and the three 90 s recoveries were JOGGED at 11:36 / 10:23 / 13:36 with no decay, breaking the two-for-two walked pattern one session before Friday's 90 s jog ask becomes load-bearing (Adj #293). Cadence 171/169/173/170 is sub-band a third consecutive road outing and did not rise with the faster pace — the extra 5 s/mi came from stride length, not turnover; next read Friday at I (Adj #294). HR 170/179/178/182 (peak 182 vs W17's 186 while 3 s/mi faster) and power 261/255/256/260 W are display-only. WU 1.30 mi @ 10:20, CD walked 1 mi. Road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — eleventh consecutive quality outing clean.
